**plugin:** `pixel install github:…` now installs the release asset `pixel-<name>-<target>` over a program the repository ships at `run` (the launcher the Pixel-CLI plugins commit), instead of keeping a launcher that fails on the first run. Without an asset it no longer reports a bare success: it prints the `cargo install --git … --force` command that builds the program into the plugin, and a failed download leaves the shipped file intact.
